title: 第12章 三大不朽第13章 皇老
lines: 死寂！
绝对的、令人窒息的死寂，再次笼罩了战场！
这一次，连呼吸声都仿佛消失了。
君家所有人，无论是正在激战的长老，还是残余的天骄，脸上的表情彻底凝固，化作了无边的空白和深入骨髓的绝望！
他们心目中无敌的神只……陨落了？！
被……被一拳打成了虚无？！
“逍……逍遥神子！
一位君家长老发出撕心裂肺的悲鸣，心神遭受重创，被对面的紫家长老抓住破绽，一掌轰得吐血倒飞！
君天命目眦欲裂，枯瘦的身躯剧烈颤抖，污血骨杖几乎捏碎！
一股无法形容的暴怒、恐惧与怨毒，瞬间吞噬了他的理智！
“孽障！
孽障啊！
君家家主君临世在远处发出震碎星河的咆哮，双目赤红如血，气息狂暴混乱，几乎要不顾一切地扑杀过来！
而后，就在这片因君逍遥彻底陨灭而引发的滔天混乱与绝望之中——
“敢杀吾族神子……”
一个声音，突兀地响彻在天地之间！
这声音并不高亢，甚至带着一种奇异的平静。
然而，就在它响起的瞬间，整个紫曜神域，不，是整个恒宇地南域核心的这片浩瀚星空，都仿佛……凝固了！
时间停止了流动！
空间化作了琥珀！
法则陷入了沉寂！
一股无法用言语形容的恐怖意志，如同沉睡亿万载的太古巨兽苏醒，带着碾碎一切的无上威严，轰然降临！
“诸天万界……皆无尔等活路！”
声音落下的刹那，一道身影，无声无息地出现在战场的最上空。
那是一个无法看清具体容貌的身影，仿佛笼罩在无尽的时光迷雾与空间褶皱之中。
只能隐约看到，他穿着一件极其古老的灰麻布袍，身形枯瘦，仿佛一阵风就能吹倒。
然而，就是这样一个看似枯槁的身影，仅仅只是站在那里，就成为了整个宇宙的中心！
浩瀚无边的星域在他脚下臣服，亿万星辰的光芒在他面前黯淡！
一种超越了祖神境、彻底凌驾于不朽之路境界之上的终极威压，如同亿万座太古神山，轰然压在每一个生灵的心头！
content_en:
Dead silence!
Absolute, suffocating silence enveloped the battlefield again!
This time, even the sound of breathing seemed to disappear.
Everyone in the Jun family, whether they were the elders who were fighting fiercely or the remaining geniuses, the expressions on their faces were completely frozen, turning into boundless blankness and bone-deep despair!
The invincible god in their minds... has fallen? !
Being... punched into nothingness? !
"Xiao...Xiaoyao God Son!
! "
An elder from the Jun family let out a heart-rending cry, and his mind was severely damaged. The elder from the Zi family on the opposite side caught him and sent him vomiting blood and flying backwards with a palm strike!
“No—!
! "
Jun Tianming's eyes were about to burst, his skinny body was shaking violently, and the bloody bone staff was almost crushed!
An indescribable rage, fear and resentment instantly swallowed up his sanity!
"Evil!
What a sin!
! "
Jun Linshi, the head of the Jun family, let out a roar that shattered the galaxy in the distance. His eyes were as red as blood, his aura was violent and chaotic, and he was almost going to kill him desperately!
Then, in the midst of the chaos and despair caused by Jun Xiaoyao's complete demise——
"Dare to kill the son of our god..."
A voice suddenly resounded between heaven and earth!
The voice was not high-pitched, and even had a strange calmness to it.
However, the moment it sounded, the entire Zi Yao Divine Territory, no, the vast starry sky at the core of the entire Hengyu Southern Territory, seemed to... freeze!
Time has stopped flowing!
The space turned into amber!
The law fell into silence!
A terrifying will that cannot be described in words, like the awakening of an ancient behemoth that has been sleeping for billions of years, suddenly descends with the supreme majesty of crushing everything!
"There is no way for you to survive in all the worlds..."
The moment the voice fell, a figure appeared silently at the top of the battlefield.
It was a figure whose specific appearance could not be seen clearly, as if shrouded in the endless fog of time and folds of space.
It could only be vaguely seen that he was wearing an extremely ancient gray linen robe, and his figure was so thin that it seemed as if a gust of wind could blow him over.
However, just such a haggard-looking figure became the center of the entire universe just by standing there!
The vast star field surrendered under his feet, and the light of billions of stars dimmed in front of him!
An ultimate coercion that transcends the realm of the Ancestral God and completely towers over the realm of the Immortal Road, like billions of ancient sacred mountains, crashes into the heart of every living being!
